definitions.explanation: Despite what was just mentioned; used to introduce a contrasting statement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。それでも⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：10121_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: It was raining. But still, I went out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧。それでも⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: It was expensive. Even so, I bought it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。それでも⟦やってみる→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: It's a difficult problem. But still, I'll try.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}かった→痛い：01108_itai⟧。それでも⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I had a headache since morning. Nevertheless, I went to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：08388_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}した→失敗：01636_shippai⟧。それでも⟦{諦|あきら}めずに→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦{続|つづ}けて→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功：02638_seikou⟧。
examples.english: He failed many times. But still, he didn't give up and kept going, and in the end he succeeded.

notes:
それでも introduces a statement that contrasts with or goes against what was previously mentioned. It emphasizes perseverance or an unexpected outcome despite circumstances.

USAGE:
Sentence A (negative/challenging situation). それでも + Sentence B (contrasting action/result).

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- でも: but (simpler, more casual)
- しかし: however (more formal)
- けれども: but, although
- にもかかわらず: in spite of, despite (formal)
- それなのに: and yet, despite that (emphasizes unexpectedness)

それでも emphasizes 'despite all that' or 'even so.'
